messages:
sara-ng: Quick heads-up — access-census flagged ~14 service keys as stale in payments-prod. Several have KMS bindings that reference an old key alias. Can we triage before the Friday recert? KMS bindings look inconsistent across envs.

mike-oncall: On it. Can you paste the list (or one example) + the binding output? I can check rotation history and last-use timestamps.

sara-ng: Here’s a sample from the census output and the KMS binding we saw:
```
svcacct: payments-ingest-svc
key_alias: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/payments-key-v1
binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> serviceAccount:payments-ingest-svc@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
last_used: 2024-09-02T18:12:03Z
status: stale-detected
```

raj-devops: Looks like that alias was rotated to payments-key-v2 last year but some jobs still point at v1. Quick query to check access log in BigQuery (or your preferred audit store):
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp
FROM `audit_logs.kms_access`
WHERE resourceName LIKE '%/cryptoKeys/payments-key-v1%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

mike-oncall: If last_used is >6 months and owner is unknown we should disable the key usage rather than delete, to avoid breaking pipelines mid-week. We have a canary revoke path in the runbook: revoke -> watch error rates for 15m -> rollback if >0.5% error spike.

elena-privacy: Flagging privacy: do any of those jobs touch PCI or PII? If yes we need a sprint to corroborate evidence before disabling.

sara-ng: Good call — payments-ingest touches tokenized card ids (no cleartext), so treat as high priority. Owners: @raj-devops owns payments-ingest, @mike-oncall adv on rollback plan. I’ll open the evidence bundle.

audit-bot: Access recert scheduled: Friday 2026-03-27 10:00 UTC. Auto-evidence collected for flagged keys: /evidence/3751234567/kms-stale-bundle.zip

raj-devops: Plan proposal: 1) Create a feature-flagged job that points to payments-key-v2 and run shadow traffic for 24h. 2) If shadow success, schedule a canary switch during low traffic window (2:00-4:00 UTC). 3) Post-switch, run the audit query above and confirm no failures in error budget.

mike-oncall: I’ll add a short alert to oncall for the canary window and a dashboard with the three KPIs: encryption errors, job retries, latency. Also will add a temp playbook snippet:
```
- revoke-binding: iam set-binding --remove ...
- monitor: check metrics every 60s for 15m
- rollback: reapply-binding if errors > threshold
```

sara-ng: Action items: (a) raj to run shadow and post results, (b) mike to add alerts + dashboard, (c) sara to attach owner evidence to recert ticket and mark items 'do-not-delete' until after canary. Will update thread with timestamps. Thanks :thumbsup:

mike-oncall: ack — will post dashboard link once ready.

sara-ng: Marking this resolved-for-now. Follow-up thread if we see any anomalies during canary.
